headline: Net income was $41,233, a 12.1% margin.
Brokerage fees fell from May on.

findings.text: The team kept $41,233 in net income for January to September, a 12.1% margin on company dollar, and $19,091 in September (36.9%), after losing money in each of the first three months.
The biggest change in September was company dollar, up 6,610.89 from August.
Brokerage split and fees fell from 6.0% of commission income in January to April to between 1.9% and 3.2% from May on, a question for your broker.

moves.title: Ask Your Broker About the Brokerage Fee Drop
moves.text: Did the team or its agents reach a cap in May, or did the fee schedule change? And when does the cap year reset?
